verdicts_or_reports.screen: Skills > Smithing > Bronze Bar craft dialog
verdicts_or_reports.expected: XP total = quantity × 6 XP per Bronze Bar (the list row shows 6 XP; quantity 1 shows +6 XP): 11 bars = +66 XP, 21 bars = +126 XP, 25 bars = +150 XP.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Quantity 11 shows "+68 XP total", 21 shows "+130 XP total", 25 shows "+155 XP total". Each total is about 6.2 XP per bar, while the single-bar readout is "+6 XP total" and the Smithing list row shows "6 XP". The extra XP grows with quantity.
steps: Tap the Bronze Bar row (list shows '6 XP' per bar, Owned: 0).
With quantity 1 the dialog shows '+6 XP total'.
Tap +10 so quantity is 11: dialog shows '+68 XP total' (expected +66).
Tap +10 so quantity is 21: '+130 XP total' (expected +126).
Tap +100 / Max so quantity is 25: '+155 XP total' (expected +150).

verdicts_or_reports.screen: Profile > View Combat Gear (opens Combat screen)
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Tapping "View Combat Gear" on the Profile screen opens Combat on the Gear tab (the Gear section, showing COMBAT STYLE / COMBAT GEAR).
verdicts_or_reports.observed: It opens Combat on the Dungeons tab: the "Dungeons" tab is underlined and the list shows the "DUNGEONS" section (Infinite Tower, Farm, Imp Cavern...). The Gear section is not shown. Reproduced twice.
steps: Launch the app and open the Profile tab (bottom right).
Tap 'View Combat Gear' in the COMBAT GEAR / gear section (Profile shows 'View Combat Gear').
Observe the Combat screen: the Dungeons tab is selected and the list shows 'DUNGEONS' (Infinite Tower, Farm, ...), not the Gear tab.
Tap the 'Gear' tab on the Combat screen: the COMBAT STYLE / COMBAT GEAR section appears. The link did not land there.
Repeat from Profile: same result (Dungeons tab).

harness_replies: Developer: could not reproduce with the steps given.
Developer: thanks, confirmed and logged. Keep testing the current build.

sign_off.notes:
Filed 2 reports; only 1 confirmed as a bug and logged.
1) Profile > View Combat Gear opens Combat on the Dungeons tab instead of the Gear tab (reproduced twice; developer confirmed and logged).
2) Bronze Bar craft dialog XP total (qty 11 -> +68, 21 -> +130, 25 -> +155 vs 6 XP/bar) was reported; the developer could not reproduce it with my steps, so it is not logged as a bug. Confidence is low on this area.
Checked and found OK: smithing list and Tool filter, owned counts vs inventory, Mining ore list (sorted by level 1,1,1,10,15,20,30,40, XP values = rate x 60), gear slot choosers (Head, Body, Cape) reload from inventory, equip/unequip updates stats (DEF 70+5+95=170, +16 helmet=186, unequip=91), gear state persists after rotation and tab changes.
Not covered: Crafting batch dialog (no craftable crafting recipe was affordable, so the Crafting XP readout was not exercised), starting a Mining session, Legs/Ring/Necklace/Shield choosers, Equip Best Gear. Debug 'Modify Item Count' button is visible on the Profile inventory (out of scope; I opened it and cancelled without changing anything).
